name: uberctrl
description: Helper app for Uberspace 7 — Expo client + on-server WebSocket agent

scripts.build: npm run build:protocol && npm run build:agent && npm run build:connect
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/agent packages/connect && npm run typecheck -w @uberctrl/mobile
scripts.test: npm run test -w @uberctrl/agent && npm run test -w @uberctrl/connect
